items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had Charlie Parker, Fats Navarro, Dexter Gordon – people like that, and I used to listen to them. So that was a big influence

ctx.x: Was he playing records at home?

Yeah, and that was another thing that was a big influence. He had a great record collection, 78s. He had Charlie Parker, Fats Navarro, Dexter Gordon – people like that, and I used to listen to them. So that was a big influence, as well as Philly also had really great jazz radio stations. So, those two things.
It seems that music was emphasized in the house, since you said everyone had piano lessons. What were your parents listening to? What music did they play in the house, if at all?
